experiment: Three paper experiments: update-size sweep, one-gate amortization, 128-gate amortization
data_policy: Timing and proof-statistics values are copied unchanged. Each samples.jsonl.gz is a lossless deterministic gzip copy of the original JSONL. Public metadata may redact machine-specific paths. Duplicate logs, proof checkpoints, native binaries, backup bundles and rehearsal copies were removed; reproducing the Rust suite recreates proof artifacts.
source_manifest_note: source-manifest.json describes the exact benchmark source snapshot. Publication cleanup changes file paths and documentation, so a newly generated source manifest is expected to have a different tree digest.
